comment: Task 20 step 4, the campaign plan's section 2 known-answer check 6, RESTATED against what the model actually does. The brief predicted that any prefetch distance above the L1 budget (l1_mshrs - l1_demand_reserve = 16 - 1 = 15) is inert, so d = 16 would reproduce d = 15 exactly. Measured 2026-08-20 on this grid: it does not. The budget bounds prefetches IN FLIGHT; the distance bounds how far the prefetch cursor may lead the demand cursor, and a prefetch that has already completed still counts toward the lead while holding no MSHR, so the two bounds do not coincide. Duplicates begin instead at the number of bursts one core issues in one tile, which is 24 on this fixture: d = 32 reproduces d = 24 exactly and d = 64 reproduces it too, because past that the cursor has no tile left to run into. The four points here are the two the brief named plus the two that actually duplicate. See PROGRESS.md decision B164.
